coverage_assessment: Twenty logged searches in Romanian, Russian and English covered broad queries, weekly January windows, sectors and boundary follow-up. Results were often pooled without query mapping or totals; web research remains non-exhaustive and is not equivalent to LexisNexis. Of 32 source cards, 7 are opened, 25 search_only, 0 blocked and 0 not_found. A final audit corrected S004/S005/S010 to search_only because direct opens cannot be verified; their earlier timestamps are retained as unverified metadata. S015 has a verified open of the exact Noi.md archive page with archive-only read scope; its prior timestamp remains unverified and current verification is recorded separately. Three candidate gatherings remain pending review; two leads were excluded under the public-assembly/domestic-state criteria; one prior-month rail episode is a possible continuation. Search-only material, exact crowd thresholds, E003 state targeting, episode boundaries, local-language coverage, the official baseline and Coding Procedure remain open.
